revs.given.metaShape: The rev of {tool} must be the rev as it was read (the rev in the read's answer; a string)
revs.given.shape: {at}rev must be the rev of the card as it was read (the rev in the answer of card_read; a string)
revs.stale.changed: {path} has changed since it was read (rev {rev}) (now rev {now}{last}). Read it again before writing
revs.stale.meta: {what} has changed since it was read (rev {rev}) (now rev {now}). Read it again before writing
revs.stale.notBefore: {path} does not exist before this call. Give rev when writing a card that was read (not for a card made in the same call, nor for a path it is renamed to)
